title: Claude can replace all your marketing team
description:
What if your ad team could run 24/7? 👀

Using Claude Code, we've built a set of AI skills that can:

→ research competitors
→ analyze top-performing ads
→ build marketing strategies
→ launch and optimize campaigns

The shift happening right now isn't just about getting better answers.

It's about building systems that can execute real work. ⚡

And this is only the beginning.

🚀 Join our free weekly AI sessions and learn how to use tools like Claude Code, agents and automations in your business.
